description: Reads a recipe's ingredient lines as written, weighs each one with USDA FoodData Central and USDA yields, and prices it with the owner's own prices when given, else dated US public prices (BLS and USDA ERS store averages, USDA wholesale prices, and USDA weekly store-ad sale prices, which run low). Returns a draft in US dollars: each line's grams, cost and price source, what each line still needs, the cost per plate as a range, and a link that opens the draft on restaurantdoctorai.com, where the owner checks each line and adds prices for one plate cost and a menu price. The draft never gives one plate cost or a menu price, and says nothing about allergens or nutrition. For a dish whose pack prices the owner knows, with a menu price to check or set, restaurantdoctor_plate_cost gives one plate cost and the price to charge. The recipe isn't stored; only an anonymous daily count of drafts is kept.

prices.description: The owner's own prices, when they give them. Lines without one use US public prices: store averages (BLS, USDA ERS), wholesale prices (USDA) and, for items those don't cover, USDA weekly store-ad sale prices, which run low. None is the owner's cost. Tap water is costed at 0.

countOf.description: With packUnit each: what one item is, when it isn't a whole one, such as clove or bunch.

ingredient.description: The ingredient as the recipe names it, such as "ground beef".

packSize.description: How much one pack holds: 10 for a 10 lb case.

packUnit.description: The pack's unit: g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, floz (US fluid ounces), gal (US gallons) or each.

paid.description: What the owner pays for one pack, in US dollars.

recipe.description: The recipe as written: its name, its servings line ("Serves 6") and its ingredient lines, one a line, each amount and unit exactly as the recipe or the photo gives it. Method steps may follow under a heading such as "Instructions"; only ingredient lines are costed. Don't convert, round or correct anything: the owner checks the lines on the website. At most 8000 characters and 60 ingredient lines.

servings.description: How many plates the recipe makes, when its text doesn't say.

source.description: Where the recipe came from: text the owner typed or pasted (text), a photo or scan of a printed or typed page (typed-photo), a handwritten card (handwriting), or a PDF (pdf). It sets how many lines the owner confirms on the website: handwriting, every line.

name: restaurantdoctor_cost_recipe

checks.description: Amounts that look like slips, such as a lot of salt for the plates.

anyOf.description: The whole recipe's cost, low to high. Null while incomplete.

ownerShare.description: The share of the priced cost that's on the owner's own prices.

anyOf.description: A plate's cost, low to high. Null until the cost and the plates are known.

state.description: range: every line is priced. incomplete: some lines need an amount, an ingredient or a price first, so there's no total.

amount.description: As read: "2 lb", "1 can (14.5 oz)", "To taste", "No amount".

check.description: What the owner should look at on this line.

anyOf.description: The line's cost for the whole recipe, low to high.
The USDA FoodData Central food it was matched to.
What the line needs before it can be costed.

notes.description: What was assumed to weigh and price it.

anyOf.description: Where its price comes from: "Your price", "Store average, Aug 2026 (BLS)", "Store average, 2023 (USDA ERS)", "Wholesale, Oct 2026 (USDA)", "Store ad price, week of Sep 28, 2026 (USDA AMS); sale prices run low" or "Tap water, costed at 0".
For a can, jar or package line whose recipe gives no size: that its cost waits for the size, which the owner picks on the website. Null otherwise.

link.description: Opens this draft on the website, where the owner checks each line.

notes.description: What the draft assumed about the whole recipe.

priceFirst.description: The dearest lines not on the owner's prices yet: their prices move the cost the most.

anyOf.description: Plates the recipe makes: null when neither the recipe nor the call says.

unusedPrices.description: Prices sent that matched no line.

title: Cost a recipe (draft)
